native.spw_edition: Selected ECSS 2019 revision versus independently qualified alternative.
native.spw_proposal_mode: Actual commissioned configuration versus explicit source baseline proposals.
native.spw_minimum_capability: Full2Mbps capability versus qualified device with higher minimum up to initial11Mbps.
native.spw_phy: Actual point-to-point LVDS versus short internal LVTTL or independently qualified other drivers.
native.spw_connector: Actual LVDS TypeA/TypeB versus distinct non-LVDS connector; no unsafe driver interchange.
native.spw_state: Actual link state; packet/broadcast traffic only in Run, not initialized from bitrate alone.
native.spw_traffic: Actual packet, broadcast or link-maintenance transaction.
native.spw_symbol: Actual encoded data/control/code symbol, not a UART8N1 frame.
native.spw_end: Actual normal or error end marker, EEP cannot certify a successful packet.
native.spw_encoding: Actual Data-Strobe encoding, receiver recovers clock by XOR.
native.spw_parity: Actual odd parity covers previous character data and current flag, not independent UART byte parity.
native.spw_bit_order: Data byte transmission order least significant first.
native.spw_addressing: Actual path addressing with deletion versus mapped logical addressing.
native.spw_broadcast_kind: Actual time-code versus interrupt or matching interrupt acknowledgement.
native.spw_interrupt_mode: Interrupt only versus independently coordinated acknowledgement mode.
native.spw_arbitration: Actual router output arbitration, ECSS requires fairness; no assumed global CAN priority.
native.spw_outcome: Actual correlated consumer result and link/packet errors.
native.spw_tx_bps: Actual selected output bit signalling rate; start10±1Mbps, Run speed device/PHY qualified.
native.spw_rx_bps: Actual opposite direction rate, can differ from transmit direction.
native.spw_local_receive_max_bps: Actual local receiver qualified maximum for the opposite direction.
native.spw_device_min_bps: Actual supported output minimum, limited capability must still support initial9..11Mbps.
native.spw_device_max_bps: Actual qualified output maximum;200/400Mbps overview is not a fixed cap.
native.spw_peer_receive_max_bps: Actual far-end supported receive maximum for this direction.
native.spw_cable_m: Actual qualified assembly length,10m/200Mbps is an example not universal safe envelope.
native.spw_termination_ohm: Actual receiver differential termination, ECSS mandatory90..110ohm,100±1% recommended external.
native.spw_tx_cm_v: Actual transmitter common-mode voltage with specified100ohm test fixture1.125..1.45V.
native.spw_tx_diff_peak_v: Actual differential peak magnitude with100ohm fixture.247..454V, not peak-to-peak.
native.spw_tx_single_peak_v: Actual single output peak about common mode.124..227V.
native.spw_tx_cm_imbalance_v: Actual common-mode difference between logic levels, strictly below50mV.
native.spw_tx_single_imbalance_v: Actual single output steady-state level magnitude imbalance, below50mV.
native.spw_tx_dynamic_imbalance_v: Actual dynamic single output imbalance, below150mV.
native.spw_rise_ps: Actual monotonic transition at least260ps and below.3 bit interval;3ns is recommendation.
native.spw_fall_ps: Actual falling transition at least260ps and below.3 bit interval.
native.spw_ringing_abs_v: Actual differential ringing magnitude no greater than.4 differential peak.
native.spw_rx_diff_v: Actual signed receiver differential voltage, meaningful logic outside±100mV and magnitude≤600mV.
native.spw_rx_cm_v: Actual receiver common mode checked with each pin relative to receiver ground.
native.spw_ground_diff_v: Actual signed endpoint ground difference, magnitude strictly below1V.
native.spw_tx_skew_ps: Actual worst transmitter Data-Strobe skew including transmitter jitter.
native.spw_cable_skew_ps: Actual aggregate cable Data-Strobe skew including multiple cable assemblies.
native.spw_cable_jitter_ps: Actual worst frequency/data dependent cable jitter.
native.spw_receiver_min_sep_ps: Actual qualified minimum separation tolerated by receiver, not automatic clock period.
native.spw_minimum_ui_ps: Qualified sum of skew/jitter/receiver separation plus10%margin, no source example3980ps default.
native.spw_disconnect_ns: Actual disconnect threshold, strictly above727ns and at most1000ns; nominal850ns proposal.
native.spw_symbol_bits: Actual DATA10/control4/NULL8/broadcast14 bits; ESC prefixes included in codes.
native.spw_symbol_wire_ns: Actual complete symbol bit serialization time, not full network latency.
native.spw_packet_data_chars: Actual packet data characters including address/header/cargo, no fixed65535byte limit.
native.spw_address_bytes: Actual serialized address bytes, not number of device nodes.
native.spw_higher_header_bytes: Actual independently bound higher protocol bytes, SpaceWire defines no automatic CRC/ack/RMAP.
native.spw_packet_bits: Actual packet data chars*10+4 end marker bits, excludes all interleaved maintenance/broadcast/stalls.
native.spw_trace_data_chars: Actual standalone data characters in selected direction/window, excludes broadcast embedded data.
native.spw_trace_controls: Actual standalone FCT/EOP/EEP controls, excludes ESCs belonging to NULL/broadcast codes.
native.spw_trace_nulls: Actual complete idle NULL codes in trace.
native.spw_trace_broadcasts: Actual complete14-bit broadcast codes in trace.
native.spw_trace_wire_ns: Actual aggregate bit serialization time, excludes credit/router/application waiting.
native.spw_tx_credit: Actual currently granted transmit N-Char count,0..56, not packet bytes.
native.spw_rx_credit: Actual outstanding requested N-Chars, no more than selected receive credit cap.
native.spw_rx_credit_max: Actual receive credit cap≤56, may be lower for smaller FIFO.
native.spw_rx_fifo_free: Actual receive FIFO capacity free in N-Chars.
native.spw_outstanding_fcts: Actual outstanding FCTs, at most7; each grants8NChars.
native.spw_credit_before: Actual transmit credit at trace-window entry.
native.spw_fcts_received: Actual FCT count over whole window, can exceed7 cumulatively.
native.spw_nchars_sent: Actual sent DATA/EOP/EEP N-Chars, excludes NULL/FCT/broadcast.
native.spw_credit_after: Actual credit=before+8*receivedFCTs-sentNChars; intermediate counter trace separately required.
native.spw_next_nchars: Actual immediate N-Char transmission group to fit current credit; entire packet need not fit at once.
native.spw_logical_address: Actual leading mapped logical address32..254;255 reserved, no default32 assignment.
native.spw_broadcast_value: Actual6-bit time value or interrupt ID with acknowledgement bit5.
native.spw_time_value: Actual6-bit time-code register value, no sampled application-clock guarantee.
native.spw_previous_time: Actual previous time register, accepted forward sequence one more modulo64.
native.spw_time_masters: Actual single time-code master application, not number of redundant endpoints.
native.spw_interrupt_id: Actual interrupt identity0..31, distinct from time value.
native.spw_relay_register_bits: Actual supported interrupt register width, may be smaller than32.
native.spw_interrupt_sources: Actual sources for selected interrupt; acknowledgement mode requires one.
native.spw_interrupt_acknowledgers: Actual acknowledgers for selected interrupt, one in acknowledgement mode.
native.spw_interrupt_propagation_ns: Actual worst interrupt code propagation across entire network.
native.spw_ack_handler_max_ns: Actual maximum qualified handler delay before acknowledgement generation.
native.spw_ack_handler_actual_ns: Actual handler delay, strictly above interrupt propagation and below qualified maximum.
native.spw_interrupt_repeat_ns: Actual repeat interval for same interrupt value, greater than propagation/whole acknowledgement chain.
native.spw_interrupt_timeout_ns: Actual TR/TRA, greater than worst applicable propagation/handler chain.
native.spw_network_bound_ms: Actual all-hop wormhole/arbitration/FCT stall/recovery bound; not sum of Ethernet store-forward defaults.
native.spw_age_ms: Actual correlated information age at consuming application.
native.spw_logic: Actual decoded binary receiver logic, with qualified differential level.
native.spw_got_null: Actual initial NULL with parity checks received.
native.spw_got_fct: Actual FCT received after initial NULL.
native.spw_link_disabled: Actual port disabled, not inferred from idle packet absence.
native.spw_parity_ok: Actual preceding-data/current-flag odd parity trace valid.
native.spw_credit_trace_verified: Actual complete intermediate credit counters/buffer availability checked.
native.spw_route_verified: Actual full port/logical mapping and all-hop arbitration/FCT stall bound checked.
native.spw_broadcast_supported: Actual nodes/routers support selected optional broadcast mechanism.
native.spw_time_valid: Actual time-code sequential validity; invalid still updates register but does not propagate.
native.spw_binding_source: Canonical endpoints and directional Data-Strobe/PHY/port binding.
native.spw_route_source: Actual all-hop router/fair arbitration/credit blocking/path qualification.
native.spw_registered_source: Actual independently qualified alternative edition or physical driver realization.
native.payload_bytes: Actual cargo byte count separate path/logical address, higher protocol,10bit data symbols,4bit end marker, interleaved broadcast/FCT/NULL and all-hop stalls; no universal65535 cap or8byte default.
